title: Create a Greentic Component
summary: Create a Greentic component through the current schema and answers wizard flow, then validate the wasm component artifact.

modules.title: Start From the Current Schema
modules.objective: Use the live wizard schema as the source of truth before writing component files.

steps.instruction: Capture the current component wizard schema and inspect required answers.
steps.expected_output: component.schema.json describes the current component answers contract.

steps.instruction: Create an answers file that names the component, package, bindings, and exported functions.
steps.expected_output: answers.json exists and is ready for review.

modules.title: Generate and Validate the Component
modules.objective: Apply the reviewed answers file and run component-specific QA before wiring it into a pack.

steps.instruction: Apply the answers through the wizard flow.
steps.expected_output: Component source, manifest, and WIT bindings are generated.

steps.instruction: Run component QA using the same answers file.
steps.expected_output: QA reports no schema, binding, or contract failures.
A wasm32-wasip2 component artifact is produced.

deprecated_commands.reason: The current component contract is schema and answers driven.
One-shot component creation hides the answers contract that must be reviewed.
